scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,admin,server -c blue,cyan,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w admin" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w admin && npm run lint -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w admin && npm run test -w server
